lines.text: Seeing all this milk, my husband asked if I'd won the lottery. He was confused.
lines.delivery: Playful and conversational; lower the voice slightly for the final sentence.

lines.text: There are six two-litre bottles in the case, and each bottle is six dollars seventy-nine.
lines.delivery: Emphasise six bottles, then slow down slightly for the price.

lines.text: Check the panel: milk is the only ingredient, with no additives or permeate.
lines.delivery: Clear off-camera reminder, spoken at an even pace.

lines.text: It is A1 protein free, with three point three grams of protein per hundred millilitres.
lines.delivery: Earnest and precise; articulate the nutrition number while pouring.
